thermal_design.area_method: Both broad fin faces after five tip reliefs, with a conservative full-diameter rectangle deducted for each screw-head access bore crossing each fin face, plus the tapered rail-root pockets. Spine and fin-edge areas are omitted; this is an arithmetic area estimate.

thermal_design.sensitivity_note: h=3,5,8 W/m^2/K are assumed sensitivity cases, not measured coefficients. Contact resistance adds rise.

conditional_limits.note: These are proposed controller limits, not validated material or motor ratings. Fit case and shell sensors and verify winding temperature before sustained operation. The duty estimate omits contact resistance and requires a steady averaged heat model; a stalled motor cannot be approved by averaging duty. mass_note: Fully solid printed CAD using each part's declared density (PETG default1.27g/cm3). Captured pads use free-state material volume and assembled COM. Legacy per-row solid_petg_mass_g remains a PETG-only comparison. Hardware and non-print categories excluded. Slicer settings and measured weights must replace estimates.

interference.interpretation: All part pairs are considered. Positive overlaps are reported without exemptions for links, hardware or reference envelopes. AABB-disjoint pairs need no Boolean. Zero volume does not establish running clearance, swept-motion clearance or correct gear phase.
interference.warning_policy: A zero-volume result with kernel warnings is unresolved, not clearance proof. The phased OEM pair has a separate native Fusion check.
